sgtconti_raindrop_refract.name: Raindrop Refraction
sgtconti_raindrop_refract.description: Procedural rain on glass. The window fogs with condensation and running drops wipe it clear, each bead its own lens with its own refractive power and fall speed. Optional static dew. Supports WebGL and WebGPU.

density.name: Density
density.desc: How much of the glass carries drops. 100% fills about one drop cell in three; the default 22% fills about one cell in fourteen.

size.name: Size
size.desc: Drop cell size in layout pixels; values below 14 are clamped for the cell. Larger values give larger drops and a slightly faster fall. Changing it while running re-rolls every drop.

speed.name: Speed
speed.desc: Fall speed multiplier. Sets the speed of the fastest drops. Changing it while running makes every drop jump; drive Time from events for smooth control.

randomMag.name: Randomness
randomMag.desc: Amount of slow side-to-side sway on each drop. 1 is a subtle wobble, 0 removes the sway. Drop placement is always random.

windX.name: Wind X
windX.desc: Horizontal wind drift in layout pixels per second. Tracks lean against the drift by wind over fall, up to a cap reached at about 60 px/s. Changing it while running makes every drop jump.

strength.name: Strength
strength.desc: How much of the refracted image shows through each drop. 0 leaves only the rims and highlights; 100% shows the full lens.

blurLod.name: Blur LOD
blurLod.desc: WebGPU only: mip level used for the lens sample. Has no effect on textures without mipmaps, which includes layers and pre-drawn objects. On WebGL it only scales the lens offset by up to 8%.

variation.name: Drop variation
variation.desc: Natural variation in bead size, roundness and vertical pear-shaped runners. Optical variation between drops is always on.

smear.name: Smear
smear.desc: Amount and reach of soft, gravity-aligned wet tracks behind moving drops. Slower drops trail less.

speedVar.name: Speed variation
speedVar.desc: Spread of fall speeds between columns of drops. Rates only go below Speed, never above; at 100% the slowest columns run at about a third of Speed. 0 makes every drop fall at the same rate.

fog.name: Fog
fog.desc: Condensation haze on the glass. The view is blurred everywhere except where drops sit or have run, so tracks read as clear channels. 0 disables the blur entirely and costs nothing.

dew.name: Dew
dew.desc: Static condensation beads clinging to the glass. They do not fall, hold their own patch clear of the fog, and fade out where drops sit or have just run, returning as the fog re-forms.

time.name: Time
time.desc: Clock the rain runs on, in seconds. -1 uses the runtime clock. Set it from events every tick (parameter index 13) to pause, slow or speed the rain smoothly; Speed, Wind X and Size jump when changed while running, Time does not.
